rationale: Optimized to maximize critical load energy served while respecting reserve SOC constraints. EV A provides 8kW in t1, 6kW in t2, and preserves reserve by not discharging in t3. EV B provides 2kW in t1 and 6kW in t2 and t3. Total served energy is 14 kWh (theoretical maximum is 14.4 kWh limited by combined reserve capacity). Final SOCs respect reserve constraints: ev_a=16.223>16, ev_b=12.223>12.
